title: Armor trims! but they give you powers
description: every armor trim gives you a power!
body:
Silence Trim: /track <player> command to see player coordinates (10 min cooldown)
Eye Trim: 30s invisibility with hidden armor (Shift+F, 2 min cooldown)
Sentry Trim: 30s immortality (Shift+F, 10 min cooldown)
Ward Trim: Strength III + Speed I for 50s (Shift+F, 5 min cooldown)
Vex Trim: 25s flight with no fall damage (Shift+F, 3 min cooldown)
Host Trim: /host <player> to disguise as another player (5 min duration, 5 min cooldown)
Wild Trim: Highlights players within 45 blocks (Shift+F, 4 min cooldown)
Flow Trim: Fast water movement for 1 min (Shift+F, 2 min cooldown)
Wayfinder Trim: /find to locate structures (3 min cooldown)
Rib Trim: Fire resistance for 14 min (Shift+F, 20 min cooldown)
Tide Trim: Dash forward (Shift+F, 20s cooldown)
Bolt Trim: Summon lightning where you aim (Shift+F, 30s cooldown)
